test_title: PYST 31: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: When x is added to each of 10, 14, 38 and 28, then the numbers so obtained, in this order, are in proportion. Then, if 3x : y :: y : (5x - 6) , and y > 0 , what is the value of y ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For numbers a, b, c, d to be in proportion by adding x, x = (ad − bc) / ((b + c) − (a + d))

x = (10 × 28 − 14 × 38) / ((14 + 38) − (10 + 28)) = (280 − 532) / (52 − 38) = −252 / 14 = −18

Given 3x : y :: y : (5x − 6) ⇒ y² = 3x(5x − 6)

y² = 3(−18) × [5(−18) − 6] = −54 × (−90 − 6) = −54 × −96 = 5184

y = √5184 = 72

**∴ The correct answer is 72.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given numbers: 10, 14, 38, 28

Condition: (10 + x), (14 + x), (38 + x), (28 + x) are in proportion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e605a4867c54902c885a2ca29502cb3dbf8c0f210acf4cac5aab87eb16025c1.png] 

From the proportion:

⇒ (10 + x) / (14 + x) = (38 + x) / (28 + x)

⇒ (10 + x)(28 + x) = (14 + x)(38 + x)

⇒ 280 + 10x + 28x + x² = 532 + 14x + 38x + x²

⇒ 280 + 38x = 532 + 52x

⇒ 52x − 38x = 280 − 532

⇒ 14x = −252

⇒ x = −18

Now, given 3x : y :: y : (5x − 6):

⇒ y² = 3x × (5x − 6)

⇒ y² = 3(−18) × [5(−18) − 6]

⇒ y² = −54 × (−90 − 6)

⇒ y² = −54 × −96

⇒ y² = 5184

⇒ y = √5184

⇒ y = 72 (Since y > 0)

**∴ The correct answer is 72.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

If a, b, c are in continued proportion, then b is the mean proportional where b² = ac or b = √ac.

Fourth Proportional

If a, b, c, d are in proportion, then d is called the fourth proportional, and a/b = c/d or ad = bc.

Third Proportional

In the continued proportion a : b :: b : c, c is the third proportional to a and b, given by c = b² / a.
